summary: Bound message list reads before materializing a web client's page

replay.detail: The first open seeds a local message projection from existing message subjects inside the normal projection transaction. Later writes maintain only changed subjects; no authoritative claim replay is introduced.

schema.detail: Adds idempotent local message projection, pending-subject and generation tables, lookup indexes and claim/desired triggers. Existing tables and authoritative claim formats are unchanged. Retired projection versions are retained for the cursor lifetime and then reclaimed.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and shared projection digests are unchanged; the new tables are local read accelerators.

compatibility.detail: Message fields, filters, ordering and graph snapshot consistency are preserved. New opaque cursors use a retained projection cut and keyset; pre-upgrade cached cursors require restarting pagination. Recipient delivery presence is assessed live on each page rather than frozen in the first page's collection cache.

downtime.detail: The one-time local projection seed runs before the API opens. Its startup cost on existing large stores has not been measured; allow time for that seed during the normal runtime rollout.

manual.detail: No manual migration or identity changes are required. A web client handles expired cursors by restarting pagination.

recovery.detail: Binary swap-back does not remove the additive local tables or triggers. An older runtime continues using its original message readers; reopening with this runtime drains pending projection changes.
